notTakenYet: A status that you wrote and that the daemon has not taken yet does not count until read_record shows it.
rule: End a child with your own status write in Dispatch. Write done with a reason when the child's work is done, folded into another issue or no longer needed: dispatch issue-update --issue <KEY> --status done --reason '<why>'. For a fold, name the carrier in the reason: the issue that carries the work. Before the done of a fold, make each issue that is blocked_by the child wait on the carrier instead. Done starts those issues, and the Referenced by list of dispatch read names each of them as blocked_by. Before done on a running child, have its worker push the work that the carrier needs. Done ends the worker's turn and the pod at once. Unless the work of the child's open pull request should land, close that pull request with your own App (gh pr close). When it is in the merge queue, first take it out (GraphQL dequeuePullRequest). Do this before done, or at once after a done that you wrote first. Write backlog or icebox only when a person asked for that move, or as the first step of a restart. A restart is backlog, then rerun_child. Say why in a dispatch comment. Write no status on a child that is already done, because a move out of done ends an open production check. After each move, read the child back (dispatch read --issue <KEY>). When the daemon set the move back, write it again.
